# temps_environment_variable (Resource)

An environment variable of a project, applied to one or more of its environments.

Secret values (`is_secret = true`) are write-only on the server: the provider keeps the configured value in state and never reports drift on it. Plain values are read back, so changes made outside Terraform show up in the plan. On Terraform 1.11 and later you can use `value_wo` with `value_wo_version` instead of `value` to keep the value out of state entirely.

Turning `is_secret` on updates the variable in place; turning it off replaces it, because a secret value can never be read back.

Import with `<project_id>/<variable_id>`; secret values cannot be imported and are set again on the next apply.

Required API key permissions: `projects:write`, `environments:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_environment_variable" "log_level" {
  project_id      = temps_project.web.id
  key             = "LOG_LEVEL"
  value           = "info"
  environment_ids = [data.temps_environment.production.id]
}

# A secret kept out of the Terraform state (Terraform 1.11+): bump
# value_wo_version to push a new value.
resource "temps_environment_variable" "api_token" {
  project_id       = temps_project.web.id
  key              = "API_TOKEN"
  value_wo         = var.api_token
  value_wo_version = 1
  is_secret        = true
  environment_ids  = [data.temps_environment.production.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the environments the variable applies to.
- `key` (String) Variable name, for example `DATABASE_URL`.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project. Changing it replaces the variable.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `include_in_preview` (Boolean) Also inject the variable into preview environments.
- `is_secret` (Boolean) Store the value as a write-only secret.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Variable value. Exactly one of `value` and `value_wo` must be set.
- `value_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only variable value (Terraform 1.11+), never stored in state. Bump `value_wo_version` to send a new value.
- `value_wo_version` (Number) Change this number to send a new `value_wo`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric variable ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>/<variable_id>
terraform import temps_environment_variable.log_level 12/56
```
